instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a low-angle medium full shot shows a couple embracing on a mossy rock at a forest edge. The man in the beige fleece jacket (R1) stands on the left, looking up and to the right with a soft smile. The woman in the red puffer vest (R2) stands on the right, hugging him closely and looking in the same direction. The man has his arm around her back while she leans into his chest. Dense green trees fill the background. The scene is illuminated by natural forest light, highlighting earthy tones.
